facts.value: Students who started their studies from WS 26/27 automatically study according to the new regulations (PO WS 26/27).

Students who started their studies before WS 26/27 have two options: 1) complete their studies under the old regulations (PO WS 17/18) by the end of SS 2029, or 2) switch to the new regulations (PO WS 26/27) with an irrevocable request to the examination office.
Previous academic and examination achievements will be recognized as far as possible when switching to the new regulations.
For general questions about the study or for study advice, please contact the study program advising.
Legally binding information on study and examination regulations can be found on the PGKS page.
